reopen_history.reason: [replay:data_rebuild] The MIMIC-on-FHIR warehouse was rebuilt on 2026-08-24 after two upstream data defects were fixed: FHIR resources are now generated under UTC, so wall-clock timestamps are no longer shifted an hour across the spring-forward boundary, and Patient.birthDate is now derived from the anchor year and age rather than from the first transfer. This port was carried forward byte-identical to re-measure it against the corrected data -- do not re-author it. Expect previously accepted divergences to have shrunk or gone; if an hour-wide shift still appears, treat it as a finding and establish why the correction did not reach that path rather than accepting it as an upstream artifact.
reopen_history.superseded_justification: Judge accepted attempt 0002: upstream TIMESTAMPTZ spring-forward normalization at mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_observation_labevents.sql:15,121, fhir_specimen_lab.sql:9,18,58, fhir_observation_outputevents.sql:9,60,62-65, fhir_observation_chartevents.sql:9,67, and fhir_encounter_icu.sql:31,98 irreversibly changes source 02:xx wall times to 03:xx in Observation.effectiveDateTime, Specimen.collection.collectedDateTime, and Encounter.period.start. Full-source replay found 574 shifted inputs and closed 1,697/1,703 oracle-only and 1,454/1,460 candidate-only unkeyed residual tuples through dependency windows, UNION DISTINCT, exact joins, stage logic, and smoothing; six per side were within comparator tolerance, leaving semantic residual 0/0. The original wall times are absent from allowed FHIR paths and opaque ids cannot be inverted. Dependencies crrt 0007, kdigo_creatinine 0002, and kdigo_uo 0004 account for 564 shifts; the remaining 10 are ICU intime. The prior kdigo_uo precision defect is fixed and no essential non-DST loss remains; contract-exempt DST loss is accepted.
